question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 L 组：加纳 vs 巴拿马（90 分钟三路赛果）
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group L: Ghana vs Panama (three-way 90-minute result)
one_liner_cn: Elo 差距与阵容信息同向：加纳缺 Kudus/Salisu、Partey 存疑且临阵换帅，巴拿马约六成胜率，平局是主要对冲赛果。
one_liner_en: Elo gap and squad news point the same way: with Kudus/Salisu out, Partey doubtful and a coach hired in April, Panama wins about six times in ten, the draw being the main hedge.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距明显：巴拿马 1730（第 38）vs 加纳 1510（第 81），中立场 Davidson 基线已给巴拿马约 60% 胜率。
key_reasons.en: Clear Elo gap: Panama 1730 (rank 38) vs Ghana 1510 (rank 81); the neutral-venue Davidson baseline already gives Panama about 60%.

key_reasons.cn: 加纳 Kudus（股四头肌）与 Salisu（ACL）伤缺世界杯，Partey 受腹股沟问题困扰出战存疑。
key_reasons.en: Ghana's Kudus (quadriceps) and Salisu (ACL) miss the World Cup, and Partey is doubtful with a groin issue.

key_reasons.cn: 加纳备战混乱：开赛前约 72 天解雇 Addo，Queiroz 四月接手；3 月友谊赛 1-5 负奥地利、1-2 负德国。
key_reasons.en: Chaotic Ghana preparation: Addo sacked about 72 days out, Queiroz appointed in April; March friendlies lost 1-5 to Austria and 1-2 to Germany.

method_note: Market-blind: Elo (eloratings.net, 2026-06-11) -> Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) p_stat = 17.1/22.5/60.5; bounded news adjustment of ~1.5pp toward Panama (Ghana squad losses and coaching upheaval, partially offset by Panama's Carrasquilla concern; recent form already in Elo), renormalized. No betting or prediction-market data used.
